name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution + sentence-level rewrite suggestions (guidance, never auto-rewrite). Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v6.0.0: reporting & experience major — new pp_trend.py (pp.py trend) renders multi-round rewrite trajectories from workflow JSONs into one self-contained HTML (inline-SVG score line, per-run delta table with improvement/rebound flags, degraded-run markers); unified plain-language error presentation (pp_errors.py) replaces scattered technical messages across four entry points with the exit-code contract untouched; pp.py help is now grouped by scenario with a three-step beginner path, and PP_LANG=en switches the entry surface to English; bundled batch chaos suite locks per-file isolation and circuit disclosure. No engine scoring changes — published numbers bit-reproducible. 零新增依赖。
